name: Almond Cookies
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ⅓ cup almonds, blanched and finely chopped

steps: Cream the butter, add egg well beaten, almonds, sugar, brandy, and spices mixed and sifted with flour.
Roll mixture to one-fourth inch in thickness, shape with a round cutter first dipped in flour, and bake in a slow oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
